mainEntity.name: What accessibility features should be included in a granny apartment design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning focuses on mobility, safety, and physical comfort for the occupant. Zero-threshold entries and barrier-free walk-in showers eliminate tripping hazards and accommodate walkers or wheelchairs. Wider interior doorways and hallways allow unhindered movement throughout the living space. Other key details include slip-resistant flooring, strategic grab bar backing inside bathroom walls, lever-style door handles, and accessible countertop heights. Evaluating these features early ensures the living space adapts gracefully to changing physical capabilities without requiring costly retrofits down the road.
acceptedAnswer.description: Incorporate zero-threshold entries, wider doorways, walk-in showers, slip-resistant flooring, lever door handles, and wall backing for grab bars to support long-term mobility.
